    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #e50914;
            --accent: #ffc107;
            --dark-core: #050505;
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            background-color: var(--dark-core);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%, rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
            height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            backdrop-filter: blur(25px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(25px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 50px;
            padding: 60px 40px;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 580px;
            width: 90%;
            box-shadow: 0 50px 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
            position: relative;
        }

        /* أيقونة يد احترافية جداً SVG مرسومة بـ 3 ألوان */
        .stop-icon {
            width: 110px;
            height: 110px;
            margin: 0 auto 30px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.6));
            animation: shake 3s infinite ease-in-out;
        }

        @keyframes shake {
            0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
            10%, 20% { transform: rotate(-5deg) scale(1.05); }
            30%, 50% { transform: rotate(5deg) scale(1.05); }
            40%, 60% { transform: rotate(-5deg) scale(1.05); }
            70% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
        }

        h1 {
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            text-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #000;
            padding: 8px 25px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            transform: rotate(-3deg);
            box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.5);
        }

        p {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: #d1d1d1;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .btns {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .btn {
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 16px 40px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            transition: 0.4s;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .btn-red {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-red:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            background: #ff000d;
            box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.6);
        }

        .btn-line {
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-line:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-color: white;
        }

        .footer {
            margin-top: 40px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #333;
            letter-spacing: 5px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
    </style>

        :root {

            0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }

            background: var(--accent);
            color: #000;
            padding: 8px 25px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-weight: 900;

            margin-bottom: 30px;
            transform: rotate(-3deg);
            box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.5);

            font-size: 1.25rem;

            margin-bottom: 40px;

            justify-content: center;
        }

            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 16px 40px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;

            cursor: pointer;
        }

            background: var(--primary);

            box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-red:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            background: #ff000d;
            box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.6);
        }

        .btn-line {
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-line:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-color: white;
        }

        .footer {
            margin-top: 40px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #333;

            --dark-core: #050505;

    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #e50914;
            --accent: #ffc107;
            --dark-core: #050505;
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            background-color: var(--dark-core);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%, rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
            height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            backdrop-filter: blur(25px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(25px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 50px;
            padding: 60px 40px;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 580px;
            width: 90%;
            box-shadow: 0 50px 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
            position: relative;
        }

        /* أيقونة يد احترافية جداً SVG مرسومة بـ 3 ألوان */
        .stop-icon {
            width: 110px;
            height: 110px;
            margin: 0 auto 30px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.6));
            animation: shake 3s infinite ease-in-out;
        }

        @keyframes shake {
            0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
            10%, 20% { transform: rotate(-5deg) scale(1.05); }
            30%, 50% { transform: rotate(5deg) scale(1.05); }
            40%, 60% { transform: rotate(-5deg) scale(1.05); }
            70% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
        }

        h1 {
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            text-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #000;
            padding: 8px 25px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            transform: rotate(-3deg);
            box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.5);
        }

        p {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: #d1d1d1;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .btns {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .btn {
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 16px 40px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            transition: 0.4s;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .btn-red {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-red:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            background: #ff000d;
            box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.6);
        }

        .btn-line {
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-line:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-color: white;
        }

        .footer {
            margin-top: 40px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #333;
            letter-spacing: 5px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
    </style>
</head>
